# AI UI Planner Context

This public example uses the checked-in scenario and requires no LLM API key.
Provider-driven planning is optional and has not been verified against a live
provider for this app.

## App

- Scheme: `SkillsLocalBuild`
- Provided scenario override path: `.github/ai-ui/verify-primary-flow.json`

## Preferred deterministic launch

- Launch arguments: `["RunningInUITests", "-AppleLanguages", "(en)", "-AppleLocale", "en_US"]`.
- `RunningInUITests` disables animations and invokes the existing logout/reset
  hook. Use a dedicated, signed-out test Simulator; the hook can log out an
  existing account.
- Do not set `DYNAMIC_DOMAIN` or supply credentials. The starting state is the
  signed-out welcome screen, using the app's real production views.

## Preferred flow

- Assert the welcome controls `Create an account` and `Sign in`.
- Sign-in navigation may use the existing ProtonCore identifiers
  `LoginViewController.titleLabel`,
  `LoginViewController.loginTextField.textField`,
  `LoginViewController.passwordTextField.textField`, and
  `UINavigationItem.leftBarButtonItem` for closing the sheet.
- Inspect the runtime UI tree before relying on a source-discovered identifier.
- This is a baseline navigation check. It does not verify the 1.23.0 changelog
  features, authenticated vault operations, passkeys, or autofill extensions.

## Avoid

- Real credentials or production-only flows
- Flaky gestures, long waits, or animations
- Network-dependent behavior unless the app has reliable mocks or seeded data
